qualitative.gate_3m_moat_note: Lab automation software and OEM diagnostics components have switching costs, but low pricing power in OEM contract manufacturing (Paramit) and cyclical lab instrument capex depress multi-year ROIC to ~7-8% (and negative with 2025 impairment), failing the 12% hurdle.
qualitative.note: Fails Gate 3b (ROIC < 12%, REJECT). Respected Swiss lab-automation engineer, but high exposure to cyclical lab instrument capex and lower-margin contract manufacturing (Paramit) compressed adjusted margins to 16% and triggered a CHF 140M goodwill impairment, leaving multi-year ROIC well below the 12% hurdle.
qualitative.evidence: Adjusted EBITDA margins compressed from 20.5% (2023) to 16.1% (2025). The $1.0B acquisition of Paramit diluted returns and caused a CHF 139.5M goodwill write-down in 2025 (CHF -110.7M net loss). Multi-year ROIC hovers around 7-8%, well beneath the 12% threshold.
